scope: Research only. Existing SDK implementation changes preserved; no new provider changes or VIPTV migration performed. Free/anonymous routes were tested; no paid account or personal cookie was used.

recommendations.closest_catalog_match: MovieBox mobile API, with explicit English dub subject selection
recommendations.simple_public_api_lead: RiveStream/Citadel, with strict language/track selection and fallback
recommendations.long_term_stability: Not established by this short research session; neither is a guaranteed service contract.

moviebox.provider: MovieBox (aoneroom mobile API; distinct from MovieBox Pro)
moviebox.coverage: Movies, TV and anime; explicit English dub sibling subject IDs observed
moviebox.playback: Signed CDN cookies plus required mobile User-Agent/Referer; real DASH manifests parsed from signCookie, excluding upgrade-notice MP4s
moviebox.stability: No long-term uptime claim. Thirty-second 720p tests passed Breaking Bad/Jujutsu Kaisen; Inception reached only 28.03 media seconds within the 40-second cap.

query_fields: cb=<optional coarse freshness bucket used by current client>
citadel.authentication: No API key/login in the tested requests. Used browser-style User-Agent and rivestream.ru Referer.
citadel.observed_english_coverage: Movie Inception; TV Breaking Bad; Frieren, Demon Slayer and Jujutsu Kaisen English dubs. TV was confirmed in the initial SDK result and later direct browser-header refresh.
citadel.audio_selection: Some English-labeled resources default to another language. Tested required English audio indices include 1 and 3; always inspect/select the track.
citadel.stability: English TV availability/quality changed during testing; some direct requests returned no English candidate. A fresh browser-header request returned a playable English 480p resource.

important_findings: MovieBox metadata differentiates English sub and English dub. A substring match for English selects the wrong resource; choose the explicit English dub sibling subjectId.

Series titles include bundles such as S1-S2/S1-S5. Strict bare-title/year equality in the existing SDK misses valid catalog entries; matching must preserve exact season identity while handling bundle decoration.
The current SDK MovieBox mobile path does not yet perform dub sibling selection or bundled-series matching. This research validates a prototype, not integrated English-dub support for MovieBox.

The RiveStream SDK already resolves the service, but default selection and missing audio track requirements can replay Japanese or Hindi. One later Multi Audio TV fallback was detected as Hindi; the earlier explicit English TV resource and later direct refresh were English.

VidLink movie/TV streams played, but sampled Frieren/Jujutsu Kaisen TV routes contained Japanese. Its documented dedicated MAL dub API paths returned 404 here; a deployed anime bundle referenced localhost:8080.
VidZee returned movie/TV and anime streams, but all three tested default anime resources contained Japanese despite English server labels. This does not establish a selectable dub path.
VidKing/ZXCStream returned no playable results in this SDK pass; CineJoy playback was mixed. These are sample/adapter observations, not permanent host bans.
NHD homepage was reachable and advertises movie/TV/anime embeds, but a working direct dubbed media API was not verified.
method: Eight-second actual video/audio decodes through FFmpeg, plus sampled dialogue detection using faster-whisper tiny. Language samples at 240 seconds, with 480-second resamples for sparse opening dialogue. Longer MovieBox tests decode thirty seconds using the second video representation (720p in the sampled manifests). Research timings are from this connection and do not prove global speed, complete catalog coverage or visible-player latency.
